note: The Philippines (Executive Order 408 as amended): nationals of the countries on the Department of Foreign Affairs' list enter without a visa for 30 days (extendable at the Bureau of Immigration), Brazilians and Israelis for 59 days; 14 days for Indians (since 8 June 2025), Taiwan's (to 30 June 2027) and China's (to 15 January 2027, tourism only, at two airports) passports and Hong Kong's and Macao's. The DFA's pages refuse this client, so the list is read from Wikipedia's copy of it. Everyone else needs a visa (the substitute-visa routes for Chinese and Indian holders of certain third-country visas aren't modelled). Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Department of Foreign Affairs' eVisaPH policy page, which confirmed the 30-day list, Brazil's and Israel's 59 days, India's, Hong Kong's and Macao's 14 days and China's 14 days through two airports (from 16 January 2026, no end date given); it names Taiwan's passports only through the MECO e-travel route, so Taiwan's 14 days stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of the Philippines: Ordinary passports
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter the Philippines for stays up to the duration listed below. ... 59 days Brazil Israel 30 days ASEAN member states (except Timor-Leste) All European Union member states Andorra Angola Antigua and Barbuda Argentina Australia ... Zambia Zimbabwe 14 days China Hong Kong India Macau Portugal Taiwan 7 days United Kingdom T1 - Temporary policy until January 15, 2027. T2 - Temporary policy until June 30, 2027.

sources.title: Department of Foreign Affairs, Office of Consular Affairs, eVisaPH 'PH Visa Policy' (tabs 'Free to enter the Philippines without Visa' and 'Visa-Required Nationals')
sources.said: Nationals from the following countries are allowed to enter the Philippines without a visa for an initial stay of thirty (30) days: Andorra Angol[a] Antigua and Barbuda ... Brazil* ... Israel* ... Zambia Zimbabwe. Countries that are allowed to enter the Philippines visa-free for a stay of fifty-nine (59) days based on existing agreements. Brazil Israel. ... starting 08 June 2025: Indian nationals may enter the Philippines without a visa for a non-extendible and non-convertible period of 14 days ... Effective 16 January 2026 ... Chinese nationals may enter the Philippines without a visa for a non-extendible and non-convertible period of 14 days for tourism and business purposes ... only through ... Ninoy Aquino International Airport ... Mactan-Cebu International Airport ... Hong Kong SAR passport holders may enter the Philippines visa-free for an initial stay of fourteen (14) days. Under FSC No. 122-11, Macau SAR passport holders may enter the Philippines without a visa for an initial stay of fourteen (14) days ... Under Operations Order No. SBM-2015-018, MECO ETA holders may enter the Philippines visa-free for an initial stay of thirty (30) days. ... Nationals of other countries not indicated/included in the above-mentioned Executive order No. 408 are considered VISA-REQUIRED NATIONALS
